transport_reason: Authenticated GitHub Git Data API publishes the exact committed delivery tree under a new commit identity. Original frozen execution/review commits are retained without re-identification in the incremental bundle.
transport_observation: create_commit returned only sha; an initial local response-shape assertion had no tree value to compare. A separate GET of the actual Git commit verified its complete tree and parent. No product or tree mismatch occurred.
platform_status_scope: User authorization covers push and ordinary merge. This candidate must pass existing exact PR CI, including the five locally skipped real Ninja cases, then fresh-main CI and automatic tag/Release. None of these later platform results is predeclared.
added_files_scope: Only this transport reconciliation and exact original Git history are added to the mirrored delivery tree. Frozen runtime source, tests, policy and budgets remain byte-identical.
limitations: Exact tree equality does not imply identical commit metadata.
Original source and packaging review times remain pre-platform observations.
